mentions.name: ratchets
mentions.description: This tool rapidly verifies code smells and enforces associated budgets so that coding agents don't write bad code. When needed, planning and coordinating agents or humans can authorize budget increases.
mentions.problem: Coding agents can write bad code by accumulating code smells; teams need a way to verify and budget-limit this.
mentions.audience: Coding agent workflows; developers coordinating AI coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt:
Rapid verification of code smells + associated budgets so that coding agents don't write "bad" code. When needed, planning and coordinating agents or humans can authorize budget increases.

https://github.com/imbue-ai/ratchets
